requirements.text: The system shall allow users to create, edit, and view customer accounts.
The system shall allow administrators to manage product inventory, including adding, deleting, and updating product details.
The system shall provide a shopping cart for customers to reserve items before purchase.
The system shall support order confirmation and provide order status tracking.
The system shall provide a search engine for customers to find products.
The system shall implement a plug-in API to allow for future software enhancements.
The system shall send email confirmations to customers upon order completion.
The system shall send email notifications to administrators regarding technical queries.
The system shall be operational in less than 1 minute after the USB device is plugged in.
The system shall support 1000 concurrent logged-in customers.
The system shall retrieve 200 products per second.
The system shall add a product to the shopping cart in less than 2ms.
The system shall search for a product in less than 1 second.
The system shall use Secure Socket Layer (SSL) for all communications.
The system shall encrypt all customer data in the database.
The system shall auto-detect and block IP Denial of Service (DOS) attacks.
The system shall validate credit cards against fraud.
The system shall maintain an availability of 99.99%.
The system shall support an optional mirror site for backups.
The system shall be compatible with Microsoft Internet Explorer 6/7 and Netscape Communicator 4/5.
The system shall provide online help via the web interface.
The system shall be delivered as a plug-and-play device on a USB key requiring no software installation.
The system shall use a SQL-based database for inventory storage.
